mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN student st ON st.id = g.student_id AND st.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = st.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = g.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN semester se ON se.id = g.semester_id AND se.deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.name AS name, COUNT(g.id) AS value FROM (SELECT '90-100' AS name, 90 AS min_score, 100 AS max_score UNION ALL SELECT '80-89', 80, 89 UNION ALL SELECT '70-79', 70, 79 UNION ALL SELECT '60-69', 60, 69 UNION ALL SELECT '60以下', 0, 59) t LEFT JOIN course_grade g ON g.total_score BETWEEN t.min_score AND t.max_score AND g.deleted = 0 AND g.total_score IS NOT NULL AND g.course_id = #{courseId} AND g.semester_id = #{semesterId} GROUP BY t.name, t.min_score ORDER BY t.min_score DESC

SELECT g.semester_id AS semesterId, se.semester_name AS semesterName, ROUND(SUM(g.grade_point * c.credit) / NULLIF(SUM(c.credit), 0), 2) AS gradePoint, ROUND(SUM(g.total_score * c.credit) / NULLIF(SUM(c.credit), 0), 2) AS averageScore, COUNT(g.id) AS courseCount, SUM(c.credit) AS earnedCredit FROM course_grade g INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = g.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.credit > 0 LEFT JOIN semester se ON se.id = g.semester_id AND se.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0 AND g.student_id = #{studentId} AND g.status = 1 AND g.total_score IS NOT NULL AND g.grade_point IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.semester_id, se.semester_name ORDER BY se.start_date ASC, g.semester_id ASC
